desc: 樱花粉氛围的泵瓶泡沫洁面乳套图，绵密泡沫与温和清洁主张
leaf: 氨基酸泡沫洁面乳（泵瓶装）
name: 樱花粉润温和泡沫洁面乳款

shots.intent: 搜索首屏一眼点击，干净合规的白底泵瓶主体
一秒传达温和清洁核心卖点，承接樱花粉氛围
放大普通洁面后紧绷干燥的不适，引出温和方案
代入真实晨间洁面场景，用双手与泡沫营造清爽舒适
用细腻绵密的泡沫质地特写证明温和亲肤
用水润滴珠质地特写呼应洁净润泽的产品印象
以日常与出行两格卡片覆盖使用场景，宽展适用范围
以留白的资质占位与洁净画面降低购买顾虑
以组合套装陈列给出超值感与完整护理预期
以强调色收口促单，给出明确行动引导

style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, cherry-blossom blush pink #F7E8EA and warm beige #F3EDE6 for infographic, scene and closing shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and soft rounded info cards, single rose accent
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, gentle front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, dreamy blossom-mist glow, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft floral skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cherry-blossom blush pink #F7E8EA, deep rose accent #A5646C and warm charcoal text #4A3F41; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; minimal thin-line icon style; clean airy skincare photography with dreamy blossom-mist backdrops mixed with minimal rounded infographic cards; stable upright product presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright bottle presentation, consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte blush-pink podium #F2DFE2 and matte light-stone counter #E9E2E4
